description: This header file defines the prototypes for exported functions related to the Slap Sco Buffer object in the SLAP environment. It includes function declarations for creating, removing, enrolling, initializing, and resetting the buffer object.

methods.name: SlapCreateScoBuffer
methods.description: Creates an instance of the SLAP SCO buffer object, taking container and owner contexts as parameters.

methods.name: SlapScoBufCreate
methods.description: Creates the SCO buffer object with specified contexts.

methods.name: SlapScoBufRemove
methods.description: Removes the SCO buffer object, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: SlapScoBufEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects for the SCO buffer functionality.

methods.name: SlapScoBufReset
methods.description: Resets the state of the SCO buffer object to default.
